amendment_reason: The parent remains terminally parked under the canonical registry. A fresh pre-outcome engineering successor now freezes a design-only segmented source contract so the exact information-bearing PRE and LATE ranges can be quoted without changing the signal or opening validation/outcomes.
required_behavior: Preserve the parent V9 full-window profile, parked download guard, and immutable FREE_QUOTE_F8CC5869 evidence byte-exact.
Add an explicit design-segments profile/action to the existing acquisition tool; do not create a second acquisition utility or parallel toolchain.
Bind the exact two-row successor registry history, prereg hash, task-packet hash and clock hash before any plan or remote operation.
Select exactly EVT0001 through EVT0329 by UTC year 2019-2020 from the frozen clock and emit exactly 658 request identities: PRE [T-60,T-15) and LATE [T+45,T+60).
Use dataset GLBX.MDP3, schema mbp-10, symbol 6E.v.0, stype_in continuous and stype_out instrument_id for every request.
Write the design plan only under the dedicated D-side design-segment root and reject FILE_COMMON, C-side datasets, 2021+, middle-window ranges, duplicate identities or noncanonical bounds.
The free quote must call only metadata get_cost and get_billable_size for each of the 658 exact requests, with fully audited actual-attempt counters and bounded retry behavior inherited from V8.
Keep download/payment authority fail-closed before any metadata live re-quote or timeseries call; V10 has no positive Owner USD ceiling.
Generate an immutable quote evidence snapshot only after successful reconciliation; never overwrite the parent evidence directory.
red_first_acceptance_tests: Exact parent V9 controls and exact successor history pass; mutation, reordering or later successor rows fail.
The plan contains 329 design clocks, 658 unique request identities and exactly 19,740 requested seconds with zero validation clocks.
Each event has one PRE and one LATE segment, all intervals are half-open canonical bounds, request overlap is zero, and no 2021+ request exists.
Every metadata call receives the exact frozen request arguments; successful counters equal 658 cost plus 658 billable-size calls, while actual attempts are bounded between 658 and 1,974 per endpoint.
Any download action fails before metadata or timeseries client access because payment authority is absent.
All existing parent-profile tests remain green and immutable F8 evidence plus its child hashes remain exact.
